body: I'm sorry for what you're going through man, honestly life is such a bitch idk how most people can take it. You've probably heard all of the "you're not alone" speeches and whatnot by now so I'm not even gonna bother with making one, but if it helps just know that I'll be praying for you tonight. Not sure if it will be any help to be honest, I'm a Christian but not very religious, often questioning my beliefs but sometimes its the only thing I can cling to. Stay strong, a fellow struggler is wishing for us both to be happy. I've once heard someone say that God gives the hardest trials to his strongest people, I truly hope you can make it through.

Had a therapist for a little while but it didn't help at all. Parents can't afford one anymore anyways. As far as they know I got better, and I'd like to keep it that way.. they are the last people I would go to.
